items.name: ROG Strix G16 2023
items.description: Peak laptop. Trash battery life. Motherboard got replaced twice but ASUS replaced it for me. Plays nearly every triple A game with DLSS carrying. Overall good.

items.name: OnePlus 15R
items.description: Great phone. Decent cameras. Decent battery life. Snappy enough for chill games like Asphalt. Not that heavy. Decent one-hand use.

items.name: Skullcandy Dime 3
items.description: Great headphones, good battery life, nice audio. Feels better than my old Dimes. They don't hurt my ears.
